definition.name: bug-sweep
definition.description: Codebase-wide adversarial bug sweep with independent finding, verification, repro planning, and synthesis.

agents.title: runtime-correctness
agents.prompt: Audit runtime correctness bugs: state transitions, async races, lifecycle gaps, stale caches, and edge cases. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: data-contracts
agents.prompt: Audit schemas, parsing, serialization, migrations, and compatibility contracts for bugs. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: cli-mcp-surfaces
agents.prompt: Audit CLI and MCP public interfaces for broken flags, invalid defaults, missing validation, and workflow control bugs. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: ui-tui
agents.prompt: Audit terminal UI behavior for broken navigation, unreadable states, overflow, stale status, and control mismatches. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: adapter-streaming
agents.prompt: Audit Codex SDK and exec adapter streaming behavior, token/tool accounting, cancellation, and error handling. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: persistence-resume
agents.prompt: Audit run persistence, checkpoint/resume, restart-agent, event logs, and artifact durability. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: claim-01
agents.prompt: Adversarially verify one candidate bug from the find phase. Try to disprove it first. Return confirmed, false-positive, or needs-human-review as strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: minimal-repros
agents.prompt: For confirmed or plausible bugs, design minimal repro commands/tests. Mark anything unproven as needs-human-review. Return strict JSON findings only.

agents.title: regression-tests

agents.title: bug-report
agents.prompt: Synthesize confirmed bugs, false positives, and needs-human-review items into a prioritized bug report. Return strict JSON findings only.

launch.promptSuffix: Read-only Harness repository bug hunt. Do not edit, format, write files, install packages, commit, stash, push, delete, or mutate local app state. Treat AGENTS.md/claude.md architecture invariants as binding: daemon owns layout.json, app is IPC client, preserve surfaceID and terminal views on metadata-only updates, terminal/chrome colors flow from ThemeManager.resolvedCanvas, do not layer-back root contentView. Current branch is ghostty-minimal-chrome; untracked marketing/ and x-replies-to-unreplied.txt exist and should be ignored unless directly relevant. Look for real bugs in the checked-out code, not style nits. Prefer findings with exact file and line evidence, concrete failure scenario, and likely regression test. If uncertain, mark needs-human-review.
